verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an agent SDK, since it keeps session history and sends traces to a hosted dashboard. However, the evidence documents no way to export sessions, traces, or other data in open formats. Being provider-agnostic and offering the option to disable tracing are related to avoiding lock-in, but neither is an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
